title: Data and code for: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
description: Run records, task inputs, reference outputs, analysis data, and the code of the study (data simulation, reference implementations, the harness that ran the models, scoring, and analysis) for 43,200 runs of six large language models on 40 econometric tasks in Stata, R, and Python. README.md describes the folders and the reproduction steps.
